description: Source code for the MasterPage class in Apache Spark's web UI, responsible for rendering the master node's status page including applications, workers, drivers, and resources.

classes.name: MasterPage
classes.description: A web UI page class for displaying Spark master node status, applications, workers, drivers, and resources.

methods.name: getMasterState
methods.description: Retrieves the current state of the Spark master node synchronously.

methods.name: renderJson
methods.description: Generates JSON representation of the master state, with optional specific data based on URL.

methods.name: handleAppKillRequest
methods.description: Handles HTTP request to kill a specific application.

methods.name: handleDriverKillRequest
methods.description: Handles HTTP request to kill a specific driver.

methods.name: handleKillRequest
methods.description: Performs the kill action if permissions and flags are valid.

methods.name: formatWorkerResourcesDetails
methods.description: Formats resource details for a worker node.

methods.name: formatMasterResourcesInUse
methods.description: Calculates and formats total and used resources across alive workers.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders the HTML page displaying the master node status, applications, workers, drivers, and resources.

methods.name: workerRow
methods.description: Generates a table row for a worker node.

methods.name: appRow
methods.description: Generates a table row for an application.

methods.name: activeDriverRow
methods.description: Generates a table row for an active driver.

methods.name: completedDriverRow
methods.description: Generates a table row for a completed driver.

methods.name: driverRow
methods.description: Generates a table row for a driver, with optional duration display.
